answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 25 POA bond; each epoch three random peers replay a sample of its work, two failed replays slash the bond and freeze payouts. A walnut-shell token marks each batch on a pigment ledger peers can re-check, and a saffron badge of passed audits cannot be faked. Forging 1,000 identities locks 25,000 POA plus 2,000 POA per epoch in fees while one honest agent pays 25 POA once and keeps its share.
